FIELDS.NAME: Tech Restore Electronics
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Tech Lane, Suite 500, Tech City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Tech Restore Electronics, we operate as a full-service retail electronics store specializing in the sale and repair of a wide range of electronic devices, including smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other consumer electronics. Our operations are focused on providing exceptional customer service, expert repairs, and a broad inventory of the latest electronics. 

We are dedicated to serving our community, ensuring operational stability and a strong trust relationship with our customers. Our store is strategically located in a high-traffic commercial area, and we have implemented comprehensive security measures, including a central alarm system with 24/7 monitoring, to protect our inventory and maintain a safe environment for our customers and employees.

Our skilled technicians are well-trained and certified in electronics repair, and we have established a reliable inventory management system that allows us to efficiently track products and repair orders. We prioritize customer satisfaction by documenting our service policies, handling inquiries, warranty claims, and follow-ups consistently. 

Compliance with all applicable local zoning, health, and safety regulations is a fundamental aspect of our operations, and we are dedicated to maintaining a safe and welcoming environment in our store. We do not engage in equipment rental, and we continually evaluate our products and services to ensure we mitigate potential liabilities associated with repairs or defective products. Overall, Tech Restore Electronics is committed to delivering quality service and fostering strong customer relationships in the electronics retail and repair industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a theft incident occurred in which inventory valued at $1,000 was stolen. This incident has been reported to the local authorities, and we have increased security measures as a result. The claim is currently in process with our insurance provider.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Listed Commercial Safe, Class B, Grade 2
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and security guards during business hours.
